name: bocánach
text: Bocánach is an Irish term for a goblin with the form of a goat. The creature ranks among the demons of the battlefield in Irish tradition. MacKillop notes its frequent association with the bánánach. Bocánachs shrieked through the air while Cúchulainn fought Ferdiad.

attributes.attribute: Irish goblin of goat form that kept to the battlefield
Shrieked through the air over the fight of Cúchulainn and Ferdiad

okr.objective: Define the bocánach as an Irish battlefield goblin of goat form.
key_results: Record the frequent association with the bánánach.
Note the shrieking over the combat of Cúchulainn and Ferdiad.
